name: How is Novakai Command wired today, and what should replace it?

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: How is Novakai Command wired today, and what should replace it?
Current state is evidence-backed at Novakai Command revision d1faccbe on 2026-08-28. Target folders and files are proposed. Every folder level is its own nested Canvas container.
Legend
lines: folder-shaped containers = actual or proposed directory nesting
module = executable policy owned by a file · entity = durable typed record
blue = canonical message path · violet/rose = duplicate or disconnected path · sage = proposed convergence
solid wire = active call or write · dashed wire = missing/dead connection
Select a named flow to reveal its numbered wire steps.

callouts.text: Desktop messaging uses server 5180, Messaging, AgentsContract, and the provider adapter.
nvk child is serverless and does not use B3 or 5190; it bypasses the integrated Messaging child seam.
The active failure is duplicate Agent/store/provider ownership, not B3 executing the child turn.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: Cutover rule
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: What disappears after convergence

callouts.text: Delete .novakai/agents.jsonl, the direct oneClaudeTurn implementation, and the disconnected B3 child seam.
Desktop, server, frontend, stores, ProviderSession, and CLI must all prove the same ProductRelease compatibility.
Human messages and delegated briefs enter the same Messaging → Agents → Provider adapter path.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: main.cjs · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «module file» Electron probes port 5180 and accepts protocolVersion 1 without a release-revision check.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: nvk.mjs · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «CLI dispatcher file» Routes `nvk child` to packages/agents/cli/nvk-child.ts.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: main.cjs · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «thin shell module file» Reads one release identity, starts or attaches only to that exact product server, then opens its bundled frontend.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: nvk.mjs · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «thin CLI dispatcher file» Calls the same typed delegation interface used inside the product; owns no provider or persistence policy.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: index.html + assets · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «projection files» Mutable frontend build served from the checkout.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: nvk-server.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «composition-root file» Long-lived server on 5180; composes the current packages runtime.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: protocol.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «typed interface file» Exposes BootstrapDocument with wsUrl and protocolVersion only.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: nvk-child.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «duplicate CLI module file» Writes a child Agent to its selected root, resolves bare claude independently, and runs one direct headless turn.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: contract.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «typed capability file» Sole consumer-facing AgentsContract for logical session operations.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: headless-child.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «unused integration module file» Existing route into Messaging; skipped by nvk-child.ts.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: manifest.ts · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «typed interface file» Defines the compatibility identity shared by desktop, server, frontend, stores, and ProviderSessions.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: index.html + assets · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «release projection files» Immutable frontend built and shipped with release.json.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: nvk-server.ts · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «single composition-root file» Starts one exact revision and exposes Messaging plus Agents; no independent B3 child runtime.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: delegation.ts · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «typed interface file» One Agent-to-Agent child capability; creates the canonical Agent then submits the brief through Messaging.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: provider-turn.ts · target contract
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «typed interface file» One provider execution contract shared by fresh, resumed, desktop, and delegated turns.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: messages.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «application module file» Accepts app sends and projects conversation messages.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: headless-child-messaging.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «disconnected integration file» Can prepare a child ConversationView and brief, but nvk-child.ts does not call it.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: send.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «orchestrator file» Runs accept-before-effect and dispatches the accepted message.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: accept.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «journal module file» Durably records SendJournal state=accepted before provider execution.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: dispatch.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «dispatch module file» Resolves ProviderSession and calls the Agents provider-turn door.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: agents-provider-send.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «adapter file» Bridges Messaging into the Agents provider-turn capability.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: provider-turn.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «session module file» Spawns or resumes a logical provider session.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: terminal.ts · today
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «PTY adapter file» Fresh spawn carries Agent env; adoption restores resume/model but not Agent env.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: send.ts · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «canonical orchestration file» The only accept-before-effect path for human messages and delegated briefs.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: provider-turn.ts · target core
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «canonical session module file» Recreates complete Presence or rotates it when compatibility cannot be proven.

how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.label: provider-adapter.ts · target
how-is-novakai-command-wired-today-and-w.description: «canonical adapter file» Resolves the executable once and launches headless turns with explicit Agent and Store identity.
